columns.name: siren
columns.description: Company SIREN (9 digits). Legal entities only.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Legal name from the INSEE SIRENE extract.

columns.name: naf
columns.description: NAF/APE activity code, e.g. 56.30Z.

columns.name: legal_form_code
columns.description: INSEE legal-form code (never 1xxx: no individual entrepreneurs).

columns.name: legal_form
columns.description: Legal form label (SAS, SARL...).

columns.name: creation_date
columns.description: Creation date of the legal unit (ISO).

columns.name: active
columns.description: True if the legal unit was administratively active in the SIRENE extract.

columns.name: city
columns.description: City, where the SIRENE extract carried it, else null.

columns.name: postal_code
columns.description: Postal code, where available, else null.

columns.name: department
columns.description: Department code, where available, else null.

columns.name: workforce_band_code
columns.description: INSEE workforce band code, null if unknown.

columns.name: sources_count
columns.description: Number of source families that know this SIREN among bodacc, decp, alimconfiance, rge, epv, rfar (always >= 2).

columns.name: sources_list
columns.description: Space-separated source families present: bodacc decp alimconfiance rge epv rfar.

columns.name: contracts_won_count
columns.description: Public contracts won (DECP, distinct contracts). Null if the SIREN is not a DECP supplier.

columns.name: contracts_total_declared_amount_eur
columns.description: Sum of usable declared contract amounts in EUR; null if none, never 0. Not a measure of revenue.

columns.name: contracts_distinct_buyers_count
columns.description: Distinct public buyers (SIRET) in DECP.

columns.name: contracts_last_notification_date
columns.description: Latest DECP notification date (ISO).

columns.name: bodacc_notices_count
columns.description: BODACC notices about this SIREN in our extracts (business purchases + registrations + strike-offs). Null if none.

columns.name: bodacc_business_purchases_count
columns.description: BODACC business-sale notices where the company is the buyer (2023-07 to 2026-07).

columns.name: bodacc_registration_notices_count
columns.description: BODACC registration (creation) notices (2025-08 to 2026-07).

columns.name: bodacc_strike_off_notices_count
columns.description: BODACC strike-off (radiation) notices (2025-08 to 2026-07).

columns.name: bodacc_last_notice_date
columns.description: Date of the latest BODACC notice among those counted (ISO).

columns.name: bodacc_last_notice_kind
columns.description: Kind of that latest notice: business-sale, creation or radiation.

columns.name: food_inspections_count
columns.description: Official food-safety inspections (Alim'confiance) over all establishments of the company in the published window (about 12 months). Null if none.

columns.name: food_establishments_inspected_count
columns.description: Distinct establishments (SIRET) inspected.

columns.name: food_last_inspection_date
columns.description: Date of the latest food-safety inspection (ISO).

columns.name: food_last_inspection_outcome
columns.description: Outcome of the latest inspection as published (e.g. Tres satisfaisant, Satisfaisant, A ameliorer, A corriger de maniere urgente).

columns.name: food_last_inspection_activity
columns.description: Activity type of the latest inspected establishment.

columns.name: rge_qualifications_count
columns.description: RGE (ADEME) qualification lines held by the company's establishments.

columns.name: rge_establishments_count
columns.description: Distinct establishments (SIRET) with an RGE qualification.

columns.name: rge_domains
columns.description: RGE domains, separated by semicolons.

columns.name: rge_latest_start_date
columns.description: Latest RGE qualification start date (ISO).

columns.name: rge_latest_end_date
columns.description: Latest RGE qualification end date; null when the source gives none (2099 placeholder removed).

columns.name: epv_label
columns.description: True if the company holds the Entreprise du Patrimoine Vivant label, else null.

columns.name: epv_universe
columns.description: EPV craft universe.

columns.name: epv_label_start_date
columns.description: EPV label start date (ISO).

columns.name: epv_label_end_date
columns.description: EPV label end date (ISO).

columns.name: supplier_label_category
columns.description: Label Relations Fournisseurs et Achats Responsables: size category (PME, ETI, GE).

columns.name: supplier_label_scope
columns.description: Perimeter covered by the supplier-relations label.

columns.name: last_activity_date
columns.description: Most recent dated event among DECP notification, BODACC notice and food inspection (ISO, never in the future). Used by watch mode.
